A1_PER_VARIABLE.inputs: every population variable, its selected operator

A2_AUGMENTED.inputs: for every variable: O0 series, selected-operator series, and their difference where both are defined

A3_CAPACITY_CONTROL.extra_columns: i.i.d. standard normal values generated from seed only: sha256(seed, panel, variable, origin, column) as the RNG seed
A3_CAPACITY_CONTROL.information: the generator reads no data, so the columns carry no information and cannot leak
A3_CAPACITY_CONTROL.inputs: A0 inputs plus, per variable, exactly as many extra columns as A2 adds for it

budget.exceeding_budget: the arm is INCOMPLETE for that panel and the panel is NOT_EVALUABLE for every arm

cost.unit: CPU wall seconds per arm, panel, origin and seed

advance_requires: Holm-adjusted lower bound of A1_VS_A0 > practical_margin
no panel with A1_VS_A0 below per_panel_harm_margin
complete cost accounting including operator fitting
decision_rule.interval: one-sided t lower bound over panel values

evaluation_windows.data_scope: DEVELOPMENT_EXPOSED data only; nothing here touches confirmatory data

grants_nothing: a design describes what would be done; it opens no screen

primary.definition: (MAE(A0) - MAE(arm)) / MAE(A0), averaged over origins and seeds within a panel

missingness.rule: rows with any non-finite input are dropped per origin identically for every arm; no imputation; operator warm-up rows are dropped identically for every arm

model.standardization: fit on the development fold only

null_result.label: NO_EVIDENCE_OF_BENEFIT
null_result.rule: reported as found; the design is not re-run with other operators, parameters, margins or panels

abstention.rule: no operator beats O0_IDENTITY on inner validation MAE by more than 0.1%; the variable keeps O0 in A1 and is counted as an abstention
an operator whose domain condition fails (e.g. O2 on a non-positive series) is not a candidate

operator_selection.criterion: lowest inner-validation MAE of the fixed model using that single variable's transformed series plus the untransformed remaining inputs
operator_selection.where: inner validation split of the development fold of each origin only; never on a test block

panels.below_minimum: NOT_EVALUABLE; the screen does not run
panels.definition: one panel per dataset_id holding at least one population member

conditions.requires: class == CAUSAL_ACTIVE (bound producer; prefix invariance passed if executable)
gate E5a == OPEN for the variable's dataset

population.empty_population: reported as EMPTY; no condition is relaxed to obtain members
population.rule: a variable enters only if ALL hold, evaluated at validation time from the artifacts, never from a list

primary_hypothesis.statement: the panel-mean relative MAE improvement of A1_PER_VARIABLE over A0_BASELINE exceeds the practical margin, and A1 also beats A3_CAPACITY_CONTROL

question: On causally available financial input variables, does choosing one causal preprocessing operator PER VARIABLE reduce one-step-ahead forecast error relative to leaving every variable untransformed, by more than adding the same number of uninformative columns does?

statistical_unit.inference: one value per panel per contrast
statistical_unit.nested: variables, origins and seeds are repeated measures inside a panel and never add independent samples

supersedes.why: v2 fixed neither population, operators, parameters, models, windows, seeds, budgets, numeric margins, minimum panels nor the construction of the capacity control

target.availability: labels are read only after every input's E5a bound precedes the forecast origin
target.definition: next-bar log return of the panel's CLOSE, log(CLOSE[t+1]) - log(CLOSE[t])

withdrawal: population below 10 variables or panels below minimum_panels
budget cannot be met identically for every arm
any operator fails a prefix-invariance probe
any population batch stops being EXACT
FEATURE_DAG.v3, the v3 terminals or the temporal contract are revised after review
